source_text.body:
Build an outbound prospecting tool to find buyers
A commenter built a tool with Claude Code and the Claude API that finds prospects on LinkedIn or conference speakers, identifies accounts, drafts "why now" angles and picks the right buyer.
·
May 17, 2026
Done with
CC
Claude Code
CL
Claude
What they did
One commenter said they used Claude Code plus the Claude API to build a shareable outbound prospecting app. In the tool, a user enters themes tied to the pain their product solves and a company name, and it then finds relevant people on LinkedIn or conference speakers; another commenter described a similar workflow where Claude took buying signals and turned the hottest accounts into "why now" angles and the right buyer, replacing manual list building.
How it went
The thread presents it as useful enough to share internally through an app, and one commenter said the buying-signal plus Claude workflow basically replaced their list building. The post gives no hard performance numbers or deeper build details.
Worth knowing
One practical catch: the builder said Claude Code was expensed through a Claude subscription, while confidential customer work went through their company's enterprise Claude.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Help me build a small tool that finds prospects for [my product] among [target source, e.g. conference speakers or LinkedIn search results]. For each person, it should identify their company, write a two-sentence 'why now' angle based on recent news, and flag the likely buyer role at that account using the Claude API. Finished means a working script that outputs a CSV of [20] prospects from a sample input, with instructions for running it; don't send any messages.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/techsales/comments/1t0v9me/how_are_you_actually_using_claude_for_gtm_work
